title: 19-BCV-006 - Interconnected smoke alarms

facts.text: The variance accepts certified wireless interconnection as an alternative to wired interconnection of required smoke alarms.
facts.locator: 19-BCV-006 PDF, p. 1, Purpose and Discussion; p. 2, Variance

facts.text: It applies where interconnected alarms are required in a dwelling unit or a house with a secondary suite so one alarm activation causes the required alarms to sound.
The source identifies CAN/ULC-S531 certification and the applicable permanent-power and battery-backup conditions.
facts.locator: 19-BCV-006 PDF, pp. 1–2, Code References and Variance
